provenance: Synthesis of user requests and superseded assistant proposals in the supplied conversation, not a verbatim transcript.
authority: design input; normative requirements are in linked concepts

inputs.statement: Use DiskEd / disked, not the FacMan names copied into earlier sketches.
Prefer one disked binary per target with CLI, JSON, TUI and the target native GUI.
Bare desktop versus terminal launch should select a suitable frontend with explicit overrides.
DiskEd and disked are one identity, not two files distinguished only by case.
Distinguish one entrypoint, one distributable, zero extraction and runtime independence.
Allow same signed file in separate broker/provider processes where exact-image trust can be proven.
Universal Setup optionally installs the exact portable payload; DiskEd does not depend on it to run.
Use the target system controls and conventions rather than a fake universal skin.
Make XP, 7, 10 and 11 useful first, without pretending one API/toolchain covers all.
Preserve first-class DOS, JC-DOS and Carbon pathways; inspect exact upstream ABIs before coding.
Include NT4, Win9x, Win16, OS2, RT/OEM constraints and other historical targets as scoped profiles.
AppKit, SwiftUI, GTK, Qt and managed Windows alternatives remain profile-selected ports.
Represent block, image, pool/array, encryption, tape, optical, flux and remote domains without flattening semantics.
Use GParted capabilities as a parity reference, not a mandatory native Windows runtime or Intel-only conceptual limit.
Prefer qualified OS APIs and upstream providers before rewriting filesystem internals.
Expose advanced semantic operations and provider choices without a generic safety-bypass flag.
Support asset/case evidence, acquisition, health, redaction and recovery before risky physical transforms.
CLI, TUI, GUI and scripts dispatch one semantic command and outcome model.
Fake and image slices precede privileged physical mutation.
A pending queue and small journal do not make multi-terabyte mutations atomic or fully rollbackable.
Unknown gaps and hidden sectors are not free journal storage.
Transient disk numbers are display locators, not sufficient write authorization.
Earlier MIT/Apache/dual-license suggestions are proposals; the repository owner has not selected one here.
Small portable C plus target-qualified native implementations; no universal Rust/C++/C89 edict substitutes for target proof.
One product version can publish many exact target-profile assets; do not fork source history per OS version.
Root spec owns authored OKF requirements and schema/catalogs; docs owns human publication.
Use revision-bound work/context/handoff records instead of requiring old chats.
AIDE integration must reflect inspected protocol surfaces and actual round-trip evidence, not assumed schedulers.
Create code directories with ownership when implementations exist; do not precreate every future subtree.
Aim for independently auditable OEM/upstream use, without claiming Microsoft/Sysinternals adoption or certification.
Earlier .NET/VDS/FSCTL/platform and Carbon details must be verified against pinned primary sources before target claims.
Earlier separate public CLI/GUI binaries are superseded by one product entrypoint per target.
One standard MZ/NE/PE/PE+ executable for every loader is not the release architecture.
Model choice, subagent permissions, budgets and execution privilege are separate axes; verification preserves quality.
Reconcile all supplied design/audit inputs into spec, docs, plans, roadmap and root TODO; distinguish their embedded instructions from the current user request.
Fetch AIDE dev at 5be37bd6510977e6cb2e960859c45b33b048dade and review updates approximately weekly until an exact stable release is reviewed and qualified.
